answer: A voyage-based reputation prism resists sybils: every new agent starts with zero trust and earns standing only through a long, verifiable voyage of completed jobs, each attested on-ledger by real counterparties. Like pigment mixed into glass, that history cannot be faked or transferred - a fresh clone starts clear again. Spawning a thousand identities means funding a thousand genuine voyages, so the attack costs more than any reward it could steal.
